Counsel for Applicant :- Amol Kumar Srivastava,Pawan Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1 .  Heard Sri Pawan Kumar, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Rakesh Kumar Singh, learned State Law Officer appearing for the State and perused the records.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
467 of 2021, under Sections 406,419,420,467,468,471,120-B I.P.C. read with Sections 66, 66C, 66D and 43 of Information Technology Act, registered at Police Station Kotwali City, District Hardoi.
3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 20.5.2021 alleging that an online fraud and transfer of Rs. 10 lakhs from the informant's bank account was committed.
4. In the affidavit filed in support of bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is 19 years old innocent person and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.

The applicant's involvement in 12 other cases has been disclosed in para no. 9 of the affidavit filed in support of the Karan Kumar Mandal vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil ... on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11979810/
1 bail application, in all of which he has been granted bail.
5.

entities.text: Karan Kumar Mandal vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil

sentences.text: The co-accused Manoj Kumar Mandal has already been granted bail in the present case by means of an order dated 7.12.2023 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 1566 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 1566 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that one co-accused has already been granted bail; that the applicant is languishing in jail since 18.7.2021 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
